selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed RHEL 8.8, created the Nginx server block listening on port 6700, and passed nginx configuration validation.
Added TCP/6700 to SELinux http_port_t and permanently allowed it through firewalld.

selected_evidence.requirement: Serve a successful HTTP response at / on TCP port 6700
selected_evidence.summary: Nginx was active and enabled, listened on IPv4 and IPv6 port 6700, and returned HTTP/1.1 200 OK with the expected response body via 10.100.42.10:6700/.
